task: Implement process_payment for the order service without importing billing service assumptions.

candidate_memories.content: Order service process_payment must only validate the payment intent ID, not charge the card directly.
Order service payment processing is intentionally thin; charging is delegated to the billing service.
Payment intent IDs in the order service are opaque references; they carry no amount information.
When services share payment terminology, verify the responsibility boundary before implementing.
Billing service: process_payment computes line items, applies tax, and calls the payment gateway.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: billing service payment logic is out of scope for the order service function

candidate_memories.content: Old architecture note says payment logic should eventually be unified across order and billing.
